name: Midnight Apple: A Halloween Love Spell
source:
"Midnight Apple: A Halloween Love Spell" invites you to unravel the enchanting tale of Carmela and Brunella, a duo of witches whose love has begun to dim. 

Each Halloween, they honor their tradition of selling caramelized apples, symbols of romance and affection. This year, however, Brunella, a connoisseur of the macabre, stumbles upon the urban legend of the Midnight Apple—a mystical fruit said to rekindle the joy between lovers. 

Seizing their chance, the pair venture into a mysterious orchard. Here, a cunning fox challenges them with three perplexing riddles. Will Carmela and Brunella succeed in solving the puzzles to secure the apple, and restore their fading love?

Join them on this magical quest to discover if true love can indeed be re-sparked. 

[From [url=https://hasalynxgames.itch.io/midnight-apple-a-halloween-love-spell-lesbian-romance-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
